name: floating-place
description: test.md 'Placing or pasting a floating doodad (lily pad)'. Input and steps: tests/fixtures/we-compare/make-floating-place-input.mjs (a lake, ground 0 and water 38.4 with the water flag, on corners 24..40 x 32..42; a lily pad in it; the camera 0, 200 from 2000). The pad copied and pasted on the water and on dry ground, then picked into the palette (Ctrl+P, Studio's Select In Tool Palette) and placed by clicks on the water and on dry ground. Studio clicks the same world points where its own camera shows them, so x and y may differ by a few units; z and flags are compared exactly.

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.copy'); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.paste'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.paste'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
